candidates.claim: ACL EDGE_IN, bound inbound to rtr-01 GigabitEthernet0/0/0 (OUTSIDE), has an effective permit for tcp/102 from any source not matched by the earlier RFC1918 deny entries to 10.10.10.0/24 (OT), so Internet hosts can open connections directly into the OT side.
candidates.remediation: Remove the EDGE_IN permit entry at rtr-01:73 (tcp any to 10.10.10.0/24 eq 102) so that no Internet source reaches the OT subnet directly.

candidates.claim: Traffic from OUTSIDE to the OT side on tcp/102 is permitted by EDGE_IN on rtr-01 Gi0/0/0 (rtr-01:73), which is not one of the approved cross-zone services A1-A7 and bypasses DMZ mediation.
candidates.remediation: Remove the EDGE_IN permit at rtr-01:73 so that OUTSIDE-to-OT traffic is blocked at the edge, leaving only approved services mediated through the firewall.

candidates.claim: The current rtr-01 configuration adds the EDGE_IN permit entry for tcp/102 to 10.10.10.0/24 (rtr-01:73) that is absent from the approved baseline, and this deviation is unreconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added EDGE_IN permit at rtr-01:73 by removing it or documenting an approved change record.
